title: Prepare at a frozen head of a moved release branch
description: Use a disposable gateway, run ledger, project and slot to verify that a release-range QA run whose frozen head is an older commit of a moved, untracked branch prepares at that head through run.replayStep, and that a commit no advertised branch contains is still refused. The dependency hook stops prepare before dispatch. No operator runs or slots are used.

moved-branch-prepare.intent: A frozen release head stays preparable after its branch moves; an unadvertised commit is refused.
